title: Deal health check 1:1 prep - Meridian Health (pilot -> prod)
content:
Purpose: quick sync with AE (Arjun) and SE (Sofia) to align on Meridian Health pilot -> production ramp. Goal = clear next steps to secure PO and production timeline, surface any blockers, agree on risk mitigation.

Meeting length: 30 min (tight). Proposed agenda:
- 5m: quick status (pilot metrics + sentiment)
- 10m: open risks / tech blockers (SE)
- 8m: commercial / procurement blockers (AE)
- 5m: agree on next actions, owners, deadlines

Account snapshot (notes for talking):
- Account: Meridian Health (Healthcare SaaS, US-East)
- Current stage: pilot (6-week internal trial started 2026-01-15)
- Pilot scope: clinical note summarization + triage reranking (2k tokens avg request)
- Monthly projected seat MRR: $42k; potential first-year ARR ~$500k if prod rollout to 3 regions
- Primary contacts: Dr. Elaine Park (Clinical lead), Marco Ruiz (CTO), Carla Lim (Procurement)
- Renewal/decision date target: 2026-04-20 (they requested internal exec review w/ budget cycle)

Usage & performance (from telemetry):
- Avg tokens/day during pilot: 1.4M (week 1) -> 2.7M (week 6) growth trend
- Latency: p50 210ms, p95 720ms on hosted-llamax-small model (note: reported p95 spikes during batch exports)
- Error rate: 0.6% token errors (mostly timeouts when batch size > 32)
- Cost: estimated $6.8k/mo for current pilot traffic on current config (they're worried about scale)

Customer sentiment (from last call 2026-02-25):
- Clinical team loves summary quality but flagged hallucination in one note (CASE: note id 2026-02-23-ELP-77)
- Platform team concerned about latency and stability during batch ingestion windows (ETL at 3am PST)
- Procurement asked for SSO & SOC2 evidence and pricing flexibility if committing to 12 months

Key risks (short rubric) - list + mitigation ideas:
1) Latency spikes during batch import (impact: medium-high) -> Mitigation: propose Dedicated capacity pilot for ingestion windows + staggered retry/backoff. Run a short load test w/ SE by 3/10.
2) Hallucination edge-case (impact: high for clinical trust) -> Mitigation: add guardrail: post-processing verification step + prompt-template with citation + sample evals; propose setting up an eval hook in Redwood Optimize to catch regressions. Alyssa (applied-ml) to review by 3/8.
3) Procurement timeline slipping (impact: high) -> Mitigation: provide one-pager on compliance and commercial term flex (discount structure + SLA). Draft due 3/5.
4) Cost concerns at scale (impact: medium) -> Mitigation: show cost projection with batching/kv-caching and quantization options; run a model suggestion audit and cost-savings simulation (Optimize).

Questions I want answered in the 1:1 (to ask AE/SE):
- AE: where is Carla in procurement flow? Does she need a vendor questionnaire? Who is the legal owner?
- AE: do we need to propose a staged discount (pilot -> committed capacity) to accelerate approval? If so, what flexibility do we have on price and term?
- SE: can you reproduce p95 spikes in staging? What are the top 3 suspected causes (batching, memory, kernel selection mismatch)?
- SE: can we run a short dedicated capacity test for the 3am ETL window (2h smoke) and capture traces? Can you estimate cost and time to stand up?

Prep reminders (things I should bring to call):
- One-pager: compliance summary + SOC2 checklist (attach)
- Cost projection table (simple numbers) + graph of tokens/day trend (bring screenshot)
- Example of hallucination case + suggested fix (prompt change + post-filter rule)

Meeting talking points (shorthand):
- Open with win (clinical team positive). Emphasize prod upside.
- Acknowledge concerns (latency, hallucination, procurement) — propose concrete mitigations with owners and timelines.
- Ask for date commitment for exec review; offer to join procurement call to unblock.
- Push for technical smoke test week-of 3/15 (if SE can provision)

Action items (post-meeting deliverables) - draft owners & due dates:
- SE: run staging load test for ETL pattern + share p95 traces (owner: Sofia) - due 2026-03-10
- Applied ML: investigate hallucination incident + produce short remediation plan (owner: Alyssa) - due 2026-03-08
- AE: confirm procurement checklist + internal decision owner, schedule procurement review w/ Carla (owner: Arjun) - due 2026-03-05
- Me (Nina): draft compliance one-pager & commercial term options (3/5) + schedule follow-up executive sync (3/12 target)
- Ops: estimate cost to run 2h Dedicated smoke test during ETL window (owner: Marcus, cc Arjun) - due 2026-03-07

Notes to self / conversation style:
- Keep tone collaborative, not salesy. Offer to co-present feasibility to engineering stakeholders.
- Have concrete ask each time (e.g., "Can we schedule a 2h smoke test next week?")
- If AE resists discount, trade for committed term or larger region rollout instead.

Open unknowns / follow-ups to investigate before meeting (quick list):
- Confirm whether ETL retry / batching is customer-managed or our middleware (check with infra logs) -> action: ask Infra for logs (ticket JIRA-4821)
- Get raw example of hallucination output and original prompt (pull from prod logs) -> action: reach out to Dr. Park for sample (offer redaction)

Post-meeting quick checklist (what I'll do immediately after):
- Summarize meeting in CRM + tag Arjun/Sofia, list action items and owners (10-15m).
- Share draft compliance one-pager (if AE asks, send immediately).
- Create follow-up calendar invite for executive review prep (if date agreed).

End of doc. Quick mental checklist before call: slides: 1) status + metric screenshot, 2) top 3 risks & mitigations, 3) ask/next steps, 4) compliance one-pager (appendix).

-- scratchpad / thoughts --
If we push Dedicated short pilot, clarify rollback plan and fallback model variant (to avoid SLO surprises). Could offer a 30-day demonstration with usage-based billing and opt-in to reserved capacity if metrics hold.

Random note: Carla asked earlier for "signed DPA + SOC2" — ensure Legal has a DPA template ready. Ping Legal if not present by EOD 3/4.
